use_case_summary: Workload: conversational support agent for post-purchase flows (returns, exchanges, carrier lookups).
Traffic profile: predictable diurnal traffic + heavy seasonal spikes (Q4, campaigns) — baseline ~120 requests/min, peak ~360 requests/min (3x).
Latency SLO: p95 <= 300ms for streaming responses during normal and degraded mode; p99 budgeted at 800ms for larger context windows.
Throughput targets: sustain 1.5x baseline with reserved concurrency; burstable to 3x for 48-72h peaks.
Model preference: open-models with quantization ok; want Redwood-recommended performant variants. Also interested in fallback to smaller model for cost-sensitive low-priority flows.
Routing policy: region-aware routing (NA primary, EU for EU customers), failover to lower-cost model when Dedicated capacity exceeded.
Tooling: function/tool calling to check order status, issue refunds via internal API, create RMAs; must support secure auth and audit trail for tool actions.
poc_plan: Scope: 2-week hosted POC focused on chat streaming + tool calling integration; measure p95/p99 latency under baseline and 3x synthetic peaks.
Data: use anonymized production prompts + synthetic order IDs; no PII to be shared during POC per infosec guidance.
Benchmarks: target p95 < 300ms streaming, < 500ms end-to-end for tool-call flows (including internal API latencies).
Success criteria: latency SLO met in 80% of test runs, cost per 1k interactions within target ARR band, security questionnaire accepted.
SE tasks: provide load template, recommend batching/cache knobs (Optimize team suggestions), enable streaming endpoints and example tool integration.
Timeline: Kickoff Mar 15 -> run tests Mar 17-25 -> review Mar 26 -> pricing decision by end of May.
demo_feedback: Product liked streaming UX and function call examples — live order lookup demo impressed PM team.
Concerns: demo used small context lengths; want clarity on performance with 2k token contexts and KV cache behavior.
Ask: show a canary plan for Dedicated migration with zero-downtime rollouts and fallback policies.
Pricing: wants committed reserved capacity options for Q4 peaks — exploring blended pricing for baseline + burst.
